sizeVariants.label: Short Panatela
sizeVariants.title: No. 9 Short Panatela Oscuro
sizeVariants.summaryHtml: Espresso, dark cocoa, earth, white pepper and caramel come through with more wrapper concentration than the coronet while retaining the No. 9’s oily sweetness. The draw should carry measured resistance and the burn is normally disciplined, though the narrow ring punishes impatient puffing and can turn the final inch hot. Its aroma is dense, roasted and savoury-sweet. Mouthfeel is creamy, oily and chewy, followed by a long finish of cocoa, coffee, earth and pepper. The line began as Drew Estate’s private blend project, built from unusually scarce tobaccos rather than a mass-market formula.
sizeVariants.noteHtml: Exact taster for: Liga Privada No. 9 Coronets — Tin of 10.
